callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: Something pads into the clearing — The Ugly Beast. It's here.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 8,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Grace Kowalski and Malik Ford and Aisha Delgado and Lena Moreau and Peter Adeyemi and Andre Marsh will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Sam Tanaka and Tomás Osei and Maya Silva and Grace Moreau and Fatima Weiss and Tariq Weiss will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— The Red Table II answers! Ibrahim Calhoun and Sofia Delgado will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Something pads into the clearing — Night Court. It's here.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Reunion and lived to sit here. They faced The Eater and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-4 bar reads: put weapons in hands (4 of 5 armed). Even now the wave-5 bar reads: put weapons in hands (4 of 6 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
